scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of a housing loan application I recently submitted. I was hoping you could give me some information on it.
dialogue.agent: I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your loan application number or any identifying information so I can access your record?

dialogue.user: I don't have the application number handy, but I do know I applied for a Conventional loan for $105,000 with a term of 360 months. The purpose was listed as "Other purpose".
dialogue.agent: Thank you for that information. I've located your application. The action taken on your loan was 'Loan originated'.

dialogue.user: Oh, that's great news! So, does "Loan originated" mean it was approved? And if so, can you tell me about the interest rate and total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: Yes, "Loan originated" means your loan application was approved. The interest rate for your loan is 6.99%. The total loan costs are not available in this record.

dialogue.user: That's a relief to hear it was approved! A 6.99% interest rate is a bit higher than I was expecting, but I'm glad to have a clear answer. Since the total costs aren't available, is there anything else you can tell me about the loan terms? For example, are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan?
dialogue.agent: This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Okay, that's good to know. Have there been any changes to the loan since it was originated, such as being sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The purchaser type for this loan is listed as 'Not applicable'.

dialogue.user: So, does "Not applicable" mean it hasn't been sold, or is that just another way of saying the information isn't available? I just want to be sure about who will be servicing my loan.
dialogue.agent: "Not applicable" in this context means the loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> Thank you for clarifying that. I appreciate you explaining the status and confirming that the loan hasn't been sold. It's a relief to have these details.
